lines.text: Many learners say: Fighting! You can do it.
Better: Good luck! You can do it.
Good luck! Say good luck before a test.

data.right: Good luck! You can do it.

en.tip: In English, fighting means a fight. Say “Good luck! You can do it.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “Fighting! You can do it.” In English, fighting means a fight. Right: “Good luck! You can do it.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
